status: unreconciled drawing/table comparison; no factory placement inferred
method: Manual pixel reading of the full native render. Frame corners are the outer playfield drawing border centre lines. Average the two left/right x and rear/front y coordinates to form a comparison rectangle; x=(px-left)/(right-left), y=(py-rear)/(front-rear). No control-point fit. Filled floor insert symbols and hatched elevated socket bodies are measured, not adjacent printed labels. Pixel origin is page top-left, x right and y down.

uncertainty.limits: Rounded comparison precision, not a physical survey or statistical confidence interval. Small scan skew, border width and symbol extents are included in the pixel allowance. Elevated sign/tower projection, drawing stylization, emitter-versus-symbol offset and the physical board frame remain unquantified. Floor agreement cannot remove that uncertainty.
